Title: Cardiotoxicity Classifier
Description: Flags compounds carrying cardiotoxic risk, drawing on DICTrank, a reference set in which drugs are ranked by their documented potential to cause cardiac injury. Training used those labels to fit a binary classifier, with the authors recommending a decision threshold of 0.641 rather than the usual 0.5. Because the underlying annotations derive from regulatory and clinical documentation of approved drugs, the model reflects observed human outcomes rather than a single mechanistic assay, and coverage is best for chemistry resembling marketed medicines.
Interpretation: Probability that a compound is cardiotoxic, with a recommended decision threshold of 0.641.
